fontFamily.base: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'Noto Sans Arabic', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif

notes: No custom font files are bundled on purpose — the base stack uses only system fonts already present on every OS, so the app needs zero font downloads and works fully offline.

'Noto Sans Arabic' / 'Noto Kufi Arabic' are listed as fallbacks for systems that have them; if a specific Arabic webfont is chosen later, add its file under a new Assets/fonts/ folder and register it in tokens.css — this is a placeholder-ready extension point, not a blocker.
